title: Sudoku
description: Solve and check 9 by 9 sudoku puzzles.

actions.title: Solve Sudoku
actions.description: Solve a 9 by 9 sudoku. The puzzle is 81 characters read row by row, left to right, with a digit for each clue and 0 or . for each empty cell. Says whether the puzzle has no solution, exactly one, or more than one, and gives the solution only when there is exactly one.
